deltas.oldValue: Phone and Tablet masters were flat/manual and contained no component instances.
deltas.newValue: Both masters retain their original layout and use attached AppTopBar, ContinueReadingCard, SectionHeader, BookCard and BottomNav instances; Page 23 final/prototype instances remain attached.

deltas.oldValue: Transparent state and hit-target layers participated in Auto Layout, squeezing icons/labels and creating malformed navigation instances.
deltas.newValue: State and hit-target layers are absolute overlays; 20 MainTabItem and 8 BottomNav variants preserve normal icon and label geometry and minimum hit targets.

deltas.oldValue: HitTarget/44 and state layers participated in the 34px control Auto Layout and pushed icons outside the component bounds.
deltas.newValue: All 50 variants use absolute 44px hit targets with centered 34px state layers and 20px icons; the five toolbar controls remain right aligned.

deltas.oldValue: Only Phone-sized internal Cover geometry existed, so resizing a Tablet instance left a small cover inside a large card.
deltas.newValue: The same component set now includes real Viewport=Phone and Viewport=Tablet Cover variants; 11 Tablet instances swap variants without detaching and preserve cover ratio, title and author.

deltas.oldValue: Filter/group/sort/retry/offline/menu controls had stable local keys but no canonical Figma node coverage.
deltas.newValue: Library/BookshelfAction supplies real Default controls plus Default/Pressed/Focus/Disabled/Loading/Selected state evidence; all 50 local keys have exact node bindings.

deltas.oldValue: Overflow direction was NONE and the long shelf content had no explicit prototype scroll contract.
deltas.newValue: Both viewport roots declare VERTICAL overflow; status, topbar and floating bottom navigation have explicit fixed-scroll intent metadata; landscape aliases Tablet and no Compact/Fold master is introduced.

stateCoverage.motionBoundary: bookshelf.view.switch remains sharedLayoutMorph with redirect interrupt and zeroDuration reduced motion; no F3 work was performed.
stateCoverage.localOwnerBoundary: Figma does not alter UiEvent, reducer ownership, asynchronous guards, route ownership, or business flow.
